module: Wrapper of the Easy Select tool around the editor's native axis gizmo (editor.updateAxisGizmo / drawAxisGizmo). Captures the transforms/scales of the selection at the start of the drag, applies translation (with grid snap), rotation and scale during the drag, then at the end records undoable history actions (SetObjectTransform / SetObjectScale, transaction "EasySelectNativeTransform" or "EasySelectNativeScale") and emits the hook onEditorObjectSelectionTransformChanged. Prefab offsets are updated for objects contained in a prefab.
notes: The native grid/rotation snap is disabled during the gizmo update then restored; left Alt forces traditional snap. Grid snap is applied by this module itself (options.gridSnapEnabled, gridRelative, gridSize), relative or absolute depending on gridRelative.
If the selection changes during a drag, the state is restored (reset) and the gizmo draws nothing this frame.
A simple click without movement creates no history action.

draw.desc: To be called every frame: checks that the selection matches the captured drag and that the objects support the current mode (non-empty position/rotation/scale, editor.canManipulateObject), updates the gizmo with the snap options then draws it.

returns.desc: false if nothing was drawn (selection changed or mode not supported), otherwise true

isInteracting.desc: Indicates whether a gizmo drag is in progress.

consumeFinished.desc: Reads and clears the "drag ended this frame" flag.

returns.desc: {mode, anchorDistance} (applied translation distance, 0 outside translation) if changes were committed

reset.desc: Cancels the current drag: restores original transforms and scales, clears the flags and cancels the gizmo interaction.
